answers.rationale: The billable_hours relation establishes hours for J1–J4 only. Three jobs (J5, J6, J7) have no entry in billable_hours and therefore lack an established billed_hours quantity.

J7 is a TOW at berth B12 starting at 20:00. billing_outcome marks it insufficient_evidence because B12 after-hours towing lacks emergency documentation, and purpose_requirement_failure records no emergency log attached.
The effective_rate relation for job J1 establishes rate_per_hour of 240.0 for service code TOW under service conditions §1.
No relation in the harbor_towing World establishes a fuel surcharge for any job. job_charge for J3 records only a 2h at 120/hr charge of 240.0 with no surcharge component.

A-101 is SEED-CORE with match_rate 0.20, but purpose_requirement_failure records seed_core_waiver_unknown as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED because waiver letters are not attached, so the required cash-match amount cannot be confidently determined.
The award_remaining_balance relation for A-101 establishes remaining_balance of 15000 (award amount 50000 minus disbursed total 35000).
A-104 has status_code S, but status_legend_entry only defines A and C. purpose_requirement_failure records both UNINTERPRETED and EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED for this code as not listed in the office legend.
The award_match_obligation relation for A-102 establishes match_required as no with match_rate 0 under the SEED-FAST program, which requires no cash match.
The checkout_fee relation for C6 establishes total_fee of 12.0, computed from tool L1 remapped to LASER-A at 12/hr for 1 hour.
The checkout_fee relation for C1 establishes total_fee of 24.0 (LASER-A at 12/hr for 2 hours).
Checkout C5 has note PENDING, but purpose_requirement_failure records checkout_note_meaning as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED because shop rules do not define what PENDING means.
C2 involves member M-18 using CNC-1, but no relation in the makerspace_checkout World establishes insurance rider coverage for any member or checkout.
